resources.string: Hold the side button and tap the screen for a right-click, or drag to scroll. With hovering enabled, hold the button and move above the screen to scroll; press and release without moving for a right-click. Keep the pen within the screen’s hover range. Releasing the button stops scrolling. Without the button, tap and drag work normally. Turn off side-button scrolling for the original right-button drag. If Samsung opens Air Command, disable “Open Air command with Pen button” in S Pen settings.
Galaxy S25 Ultra’s S Pen has no Bluetooth or Air Actions. These controls use near-screen pen input; distant button presses are unavailable.

With the side button held, light tip pressure scrolls slowly and firmer pressure scrolls faster. Hover uses movement speed instead. Direction lock reduces sideways drift. Pressure is handled locally and does not require Mac pen support.
Ignore finger touches while using the pen

Hover briefly without the side button to show a 2.5× local magnifier. It follows slow movement. Palm protection cancels existing finger gestures and ignores new fingers while the pen is near, plus a short release delay. Turn it off to use fingers alongside the pen.

Hold the hovering side button still for 0.65 seconds to run the chosen action. Movement starts scrolling instead. Double-click is off by default; enabling it delays a single hover right-click by 0.3 seconds. Screen contact keeps its normal side-button right-click.
Hover and press the pen in the grid, vary pressure, tilt it, and test the side button. This area sends no input to the Mac.

A listed sensor must show changing values before it can be considered usable. Distance is not a measurement in millimeters. Tilt and distance do not trigger remote actions in this version. Samples are kept in memory only.
High Performance could not display video. Reconnected using standard VNC. Check UDP forwarding on your gateway.
No High Performance picture arrived within 12 seconds. TCP may work while the separate UDP video path is blocked or forwarded incorrectly.
